definitions.explanation: A person who has won a medal, especially in the Olympics or other major athletic competitions.

examples.japanese: {金|きん}メダリストになった。
オリンピックのメダリストが{学校|がっこう}に{来|き}た。
examples.english: An Olympic medalist came to our school.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}は{今大会|こんたいかい}で{過去|かこ}{最多|さいた}のメダリストを{輩出|はいしゅつ}した。
examples.english: Japan produced the most medalists ever at this tournament.

notes:
A loanword from English "medalist." Primarily used in sports journalism and Olympic coverage. Especially prominent during Olympic and World Championship seasons.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金|きん}メダリスト: gold medalist
- {銀|ぎん}メダリスト: silver medalist
- {銅|どう}メダリスト: bronze medalist
- オリンピックメダリスト: Olympic medalist
- {複数|ふくすう}メダリスト: multiple medalist

SIMILAR WORDS:
- メダル: medal — the award itself
- {入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}: prize winner — broader, includes non-medal finishers
- チャンピオン: champion — the overall winner
